metadata.description: A bundled Claude Code marketplace of seven skill packages: Light, academic-research-skills, nature-skills, econ-top-journal-writing, writing-ai-paper, cyber-ppt, and dashiai-ppt.

plugins.name: light
plugins.description: Light — full-pipeline research skill pack (28 skills): literature search, data engineering, idea generation/critique, system & figure design, experiment analysis, paper drafting/polishing, citation, typesetting, peer-review rebuttal, patents/software-copyright, slides and competition materials. Ships 9 traceable knowledge bases and runnable code assets; keep the plugin intact.

plugins.name: academic-research-skills
plugins.description: Production-grade academic research pipeline (4 skills, 35+ modes, multi-agent ensemble): research → write → review → revise → finalize, with deep-research, citation-verification gates, and a Material Passport pipeline.

plugins.name: nature-skills
plugins.description: Nature-style research skills (12): academic search, citation, data, figures, paper-to-patent, paper-to-PPT, polishing, reading/translation, reviewer response, peer review, scientific writing, plus an OpenClaw medical module.

plugins.name: econ-top-journal-writing
plugins.description: Economics top-journal writing workflow (5 skills): workflow router, English economics writing, Chinese top-journal writing, bilingual table/figure design, and a multi-agent writing controller.

plugins.name: writing-ai-paper
plugins.description: Writing AI Conference Papers — the beginner's handbook by hzwer and DingXiaoH, packaged as an invocable skill for planning, drafting, and revising NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR/CVPR-style papers.

plugins.name: cyber-ppt
plugins.description: CyberPPT — evidence-based, editable consulting-style PPT generation (1 skill): a three-stage pipeline (MBB evidence analysis + SCR storyline → 8 fixed visual styles + per-page ImageGen blueprints → hybrid high-fidelity editable PPTX) with render-based QA gates, an 11k+ SVG icon library, and PPTX validation scripts.

plugins.name: dashiai-ppt
plugins.description: DashiAI PPT — theme-based presentation generation (1 skill): turns natural-language requirements into a JSON plan, then renders an offline, browser-editable HTML deck from preset visual themes via a bundled local generator (React + pptxgenjs), with PPTX / PDF export.
